notes.title: v1.4.0 Update
notes.notes:
v1.4.0 Changelog:

ENGINE:
  
 The game has been ported to GMS2!
 

GAMEMODES:
  
     New game mode: Duel Mode
- Players fight against each other until the last one standing
   -     First to 8 points wins
    -    Requires 2+ players
 

CHARACTERS:
  
     Added Professor York
   -     Shoots lasers
  -      Unlocked after beating the good ending

     Replaced Venezia with London
     -   Has a gun and bombs
      -  Unlocked after collecting Star Cookies

     Francisco is now unlocked by collecting Power Mushrooms
     Improved Melee Attack
     Balance changes
 

VISUALS
  
     New character select screen
     Slight GUI changes
     Main antagonist now enveloped in darkness until revealed
     Parallax background effect now more noticeable
 

ITEMS/POWER-UPS
  
     Added Colossal Sword
     Fishing rod now has durability & imporved fishing
     Trumpet can be used to blow up enemies
 

ETC.
  
     General bug fixes

notes.title: v1.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hey, it's my first patch notes post on Steam! Right on! 

If you'd like to view patch notes/updates for previous versions, you can check them out on the itch.io page.

Changes:

 You can now change the font to Plaza in the display options!
 Slight main menu changes
 Changed player ground and air movement, making it slightly easier to move and control the player
 Improved dashing movement
 Fixed an issue with the players' arms when against a wall
 Simplified the gamepad controls


Currently, it is not possible for the player to change the controls for the game, which is a complaint that I have received several times in the past. If it becomes a major issue in the future, I will definitely take action.

Thank you for following the development of BUCKLER 2! Vivat Rosis!
